headline: Graduation date for the Class of 2027, a new Latin Historical Prose course, and revisions to Algebra 2 and Grade 6-8 science.
summary: The agenda includes a discussion of the school calendar and a decision on the Class of 2027 graduation date. It also covers a new Latin Historical Prose course, revisions to Algebra 2 and Grade 6-8 science, and reports on PSAT/SAT outcomes, attendance and discipline, and a pilot of curriculum sprints.
